name: PR416 Controlled-state residency

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr416-controlled-residency
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pr416-controlled-residency.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  residency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - label: pinned-main
            ref: 1bad655f5826070d1e29f54a845cdf2c549f66bc
          - label: pr416-control
            ref: 07dcc670fed1ecc6aa32e9711d4bc8830c0ec2ad
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.ref }}
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'
      - name: Add temporary Controlled-residency measurement
        run: |
          cat > src/match-engine/tests/Pr416ControlledResidencyEvidenceTests.cs <<'CS'
          using NUnit.Framework;
          using TacticalDirector.BallPhysics;
          using TacticalDirector.DefensiveAI;
          using TacticalDirector.DeterministicSim;
          using TacticalDirector.PlayerDatabase;

          namespace TacticalDirector.MatchEngine
          {
              [TestFixture]
              internal sealed class Pr416ControlledResidencyEvidenceTests
              {
                  private const int Ticks = 150_000;
                  private static readonly ulong[] Seeds =
                  {
                      0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978UL,
                      0x00000000D1A6D05EUL,
                  };

                  private static Squad BuildSquad(ulong seed, int clubId)
                  {
                      var rng = new DeterministicRngService(seed ^ (ulong)clubId);
                      int stream = rng.RegisterStream(
                          "tackle.roster", SubsystemOrdinals.PlayerDatabase, entityId: clubId, streamVersion: 1);

                      var template = new PlayerPosition[PlayerDatabaseConstants.CLUB_SQUAD_SIZE];
                      int i = 0;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Goalkeeper;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Defender;
                      for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Midfielder;
                      while (i < template.Length) template[i++] = PlayerPosition.Forward;

                      return RosterGenerator.Generate(rng, stream, clubId, template);
                  }

                  private static MatchEngine Booted(ulong seed)
                  {
                      var engine = new MatchEngine(seed);
                      engine.ConfigureSquads(BuildSquad(seed, 1), BuildSquad(seed, 2));
                      return engine;
                  }

                  [Test]
                  public void MeasureControlledResidency()
                  {
                      long pooledControlled = 0;
                      long pooledHolder = 0;
                      long pooledControlledWithHolder = 0;
                      long pooledTicks = 0;

                      foreach (ulong seed in Seeds)
                      {
                          MatchEngine engine = Booted(seed);
                          long controlled = 0;
                          long holder = 0;
                          long controlledWithHolder = 0;

                          for (int t = 0; t < Ticks; t++)
                          {
                              engine.RunTick();
                              bool isControlled = engine.TestOnly_BallSnapshot.State == BallStateType.Controlled;
                              bool hasHolder = engine.PossessingAgentId != MatchEngineConstants.NO_POSSESSION;
                              if (isControlled) controlled++;
                              if (hasHolder) holder++;
                              if (isControlled && hasHolder) controlledWithHolder++;
                          }

                          pooledControlled += controlled;
                          pooledHolder += holder;
                          pooledControlledWithHolder += controlledWithHolder;
                          pooledTicks += Ticks;

                          TestContext.WriteLine(
                              $"CONTROLLED_RESIDENCY seed=0x{seed:X16} ticks={Ticks} " +
                              $"controlled={controlled} controlledShare={(double)controlled / Ticks:F9} " +
                              $"holder={holder} holderShare={(double)holder / Ticks:F9} " +
                              $"controlledWithHolder={controlledWithHolder} " +
                              $"controlledWithHolderShare={(double)controlledWithHolder / Ticks:F9}");
                      }

                      TestContext.WriteLine(
                          $"CONTROLLED_RESIDENCY pooled ticks={pooledTicks} " +
                          $"controlled={pooledControlled} controlledShare={(double)pooledControlled / pooledTicks:F9} " +
                          $"holder={pooledHolder} holderShare={(double)pooledHolder / pooledTicks:F9} " +
                          $"controlledWithHolder={pooledControlledWithHolder} " +
                          $"controlledWithHolderShare={(double)pooledControlledWithHolder / pooledTicks:F9}");

                      Assert.Pass("measurement complete");
                  }
              }
          }
          CS
      - name: Generate projects and restore
        run: |
          python3 tools/dotnet-ci/generate_projects.py
          dotnet restore tools/dotnet-ci/TacticalDirector.gen.sln
      - name: Run residency measurement
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts/pr416-residency-${{ matrix.label }}
          dotnet test src/match-engine/tests/match-engine-tests.gen.csproj \
            --no-restore \
            --filter "Name=MeasureControlledResidency" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --logger "trx;LogFileName=controlled-residency-${{ matrix.label }}.trx" \
            --results-directory artifacts/pr416-residency-${{ matrix.label }} \
            2>&1 | tee artifacts/pr416-residency-${{ matrix.label }}/console.log
      - name: Upload residency evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pr416-residency-${{ matrix.label }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/pr416-residency-${{ matrix.label }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
